Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.Counterparty:cou: A natural person, including a joint account held only by natural persons.
An entity managed as a retail exposure whose total funding from the bank's group does not exceed FCR 2.5 million.
A commercial entity that is not a financial institution.
A central government, or one of its agencies or ministries.
A bank responsible for its jurisdiction's monetary policy.
A province, municipality or other government below the sovereign level.
An insurer, fund, broker-dealer or other financial institution that is not a bank.
Any counterparty not covered by the other types.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.Guarantee:guaran: NDGS: covered in full by the National Deposit Guarantee Scheme of Fictonia.
Foreign scheme: covered in full by another jurisdiction's government scheme; treated as unguaranteed for Rule 14.
Unguaranteed: not covered in full by any government deposit guarantee scheme.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Tables.RetailDeposits:r: Record ID: the bank's identifier for the reported balance.
Product: the Part R product the balance is reported under (R.1 to R.5).
Counterparty: the type of legal counterparty that placed the balance.
Guarantee: whether the balance is covered in full by a government deposit guarantee scheme.
Balance: the balance on the reporting date, including accrued interest, in millions of FCR.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Tables.RetailDeposits:p: R.1 Transaction Accounts: current and payment accounts used for day-to-day transactions.
R.2 Relationship Savings Accounts: savings held by a depositor who also has a transaction account or loan with the bank.
R.3 Rate-Seeking Savings Accounts: other savings accounts, including comparison-site and promotional-rate accounts.
R.4 Intermediated Deposits: placed by a broker, platform or wealth manager on behalf of customers.
R.5 Other Retail Balances: banker's drafts, unclaimed balances, merchant settlement balances.
Fiction.Bank:Lrr.Outflows.RetailDeposits: Not covered by rules 14.21 to 14.25: the counterparty is not Retail or Small Business; covered by wholesale rules out of scope.
